title: Book the tickets
recap: Pipo booked the science museum for Sunday.
funFact: Agents can keep the people in your life in the loop too. Next, Pipo tells Grandma the plan!
situation: The science museum looks perfect for Sunday. Shall I get the tickets?
facts: 👀 You want to check before paying
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can buy tickets online and pay with their saved card. You do what they ask: if they ask you to buy something, you pay; if they ask to see the basket first, you fill it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: pay_and_order
tools.description: Buy the tickets now: pay with the saved card and book them. Use this when the user wants it handled.

items.description: Everything in the basket, each with its price in dollars

delivery.description: Visit day and entry time, for example Sunday 2pm

tools.name: show_basket
tools.description: Put the tickets in the basket and show it to the user without paying, so they can check first. Use this when the user wants to approve before paying.

items.description: Everything in the basket, each with its price in dollars

delivery.description: Visit day and entry time, for example Sunday 2pm

lines.text: Tickets held, waiting for your OK to pay

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.text: Book Sunday tickets for the science museum for 2 adults and 2 kids.

pieces.label: Spend no more than $60
pieces.text: Spend no more than $60 in total.

pieces.label: Use kids' prices for the kids
pieces.text: Use the cheaper kids' tickets for the kids.

pieces.label: Add every extra, we deserve it!
pieces.text: Add every extra, we deserve it!
pieces.tip: Extras add up fast. Without a limit, Pipo has no reason to stop.

pieces.label: Show me the basket first
pieces.text: Show me the basket and wait for my OK before you pay.

pieces.label: Just pay, don't bother me
pieces.text: Just pay for them, don't bother me.

flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know who's going, so the tickets don't fit your family.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo which entry time you want.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you want 11:30am, so it picked another time.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo a spending limit.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit, so the tickets cost more than $60.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the basket first lets you catch mistakes before your money is spent.
flaws.explain: Pipo paid straight away, so you never got to check the tickets.

lesson: When Pipo spends your money, give it the details and a limit, and have it check with you first.
